Ad concepts for Peter Menzel · Confidential

Mallorca, shown privately.

Five ad designs — each a different layout, the way a prime agency varies a campaign, held together by one quiet brand in the colours of the island: shutter green, sandstone and brass. Every photo comes from the homes you sent us: your Calatrava palace and Establiments finca, and your partners' homes in Port d'Andratx and on the Paseo Marítimo. Each concept turns on what buyers at this level answer to: homes that never reach a portal, and someone who knows which part of Mallorca fits them.
